classes.limit: the shell cannot prove the model understood the user's intent
classes.proxy: no machine-checkable proxy; stated as a boundary

classes.limit: the shell cannot prove generated prose is true
classes.proxy: no machine-checkable proxy; stated as a boundary

classes.limit: the shell cannot prove a routed answer is optimal
classes.proxy: no machine-checkable proxy; stated as a boundary

classes.limit: L5 default trust_user mode does not classify sensitivity for the user
classes.proxy: a trust_user decision record carries classifier_mode='trust_user' and privacy_class='public' by construction, not by computation

classes.limit: L3 gates normalized actions, not the correctness of normalization
classes.proxy: a gate pass does not assert the normalized form matches the user's intent

classes.limit: L4 cannot retract information absorbed into model weights
classes.proxy: deletion removes records from the store; it cannot un-train a provider

classes.limit: hash chains detect modification, not an attacker who rewrites the store and recomputes every hash
classes.proxy: a tamper that recomputes the whole chain would verify; the spine demonstrates detection of a naive tamper only

classes.limit: closed GUI applications remain outside routing unless they expose a supported endpoint
classes.proxy: no connector exists for a closed desktop app; the connect list holds only what the user connected
